scope: Owner browser feedback, 20 October 2026. Normalized implementation brief, not third-party page instructions.
constraints: Keep required visible attribution; never cover it with navigation
Do not invent photos, prices, opening hours, transport ETA or live AI capability
Retain unknowns and illustration disclosure until licensed real media is available

comments.request: Welcome: remove header/footer surfaces; image fills display.
Welcome: remove opaque text backdrop, shorten copy to 'Не знаешь, как провести время? Расскажи нам о своих предпочтениях'.
Remove 'Сначала посмотреть карту' from welcome.
Remove bottom welcome footnote.
Welcome artwork covers entire screen, not a bounded content image.
Keep QETTYQ logo over the light image with transparent background.
Swipe: replace repeated subtitle with category-specific examples, e.g. museums, art galleries, exhibitions. Disclosure may be compact but not falsely imply real event photos.
Swipe: 15 grey progress segments at top; current segment brand green, completed another green. Remove visible numeric 1/15.
All screens: header strip transparent, buttons retain their own surfaces.
Conditions: remove 'К интересам' and 'Шаг 2 из 2' text.
Conditions: reduce excessive budget/time whitespace so origin controls fit better.
Round and style strict-budget checkbox.
Remove 'Как провести время' chooser; combine origin controls with compact main conditions surface, no extra arbitrary goal choice.
Move change-conditions control to top beside city; remove separate duplicate in feed heading.
Use actual event poster from source instead of generated category image when lawful source/media permission is established.
Remove OSM text from feed footer.
comments.constraint: Relocate required OSM attribution visibly and accessibly; do not simply remove license credit.

comments.request: Remove feed eyebrow 'Твой ритм города', heading 'Для тебя' and large time/budget/city summary; bring cards upward.
Remove always-visible technical cache/fetchedAt/coverage tail; retain meaningful stale state, move details behind disclosure if needed.
Remove 'Листай события вбок...' technical/instruction paragraph.
Event horizontal carousel: grey segments above/on image, active green segment follows swipe.
Personal matches first, city-wide Afisha second. Explain useful personal options without implying all afisha matches constraints.
Remove numeric carousel controls such as 1/1 and arrows row; use image progress segments for multiple cards.
Details: round arrow back control over image instead of standalone 'Назад' row.
Details: artwork starts at top of display, full width; darkens at bottom, content continues underneath.
Remove 'Событие · Астана'; event title overlays image bottom. Below: date/time left, language middle, price right in clear bold fact pills. Unknown remains unknown.
Venue/address block immediately below the three facts; avoid duplicated venue strings.
Short factual event description, about 4–6 lines; concise note about booking/availability at partner source.
Bookmark is round icon over image everywhere; selected becomes green; show saved/removed toast, no long bottom save button.
Remove large source/fetch/no-booking technical footer from event detail.
comments.constraint: Retain source action, required credit and critical unknowns compactly.

Chat composer: remove Coffee/Walk/Events/Cinema chips and permanent Kino footnote; only input and round send. Keyboard should resize chat region, preserving composer and recent messages.
Chat introduction about assistant, preferences/dialogue memory; future visit memory, external web search and event cards with links/mini map.

Map selected cafe: real address and average check from Google.
